subject: Proposed MAP & procurement milestones for Cascade Systems GCP private offer
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cascadesys.com>, Chris Jordan <cjordan@cascadesys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & procurement milestones for GCP private offer (Cascade Systems)

Hi Marta / Chris —

Thanks again for taking time earlier this week. Per our conversation I sketched a concise mutual action plan (MAP) to move the GCP private-offer purchase from evaluation to signed PO. The attachment (Cascade_MAP_v1.xlsx) is a quick, editable checklist; key points are below so you can see the high-level flow before we sync:

- Evaluation (weeks 1–2): enable a sandbox private-offer instance in your GCP org (short-lived test project), run sample inference workloads (our perf profile attached).
- POC acceptance criteria: throughput (tokens/sec), latency p95 under 150ms for 512-token seq, and cost / token estimates across batching profiles.
- Security/compliance deliverables: SOC2 summary, IP/data flow diagram, support for customer-managed KMS for keys.
- Procurement & billing path: recommended path is GCP Marketplace private offer (single invoice via GCP to Cascade) to preserve procurement workflows; alternate is a direct Redwood invoice if Marketplace timing is blocking.
- Legal & contracting: target internal legal review (1 week) followed by e-signing of PO + SOW; we can provide a redlined PO template.
- Target close: week of Sep 20–24 (aim to have PO signed and capacity reserved by Sep 24).

Ask: please confirm procurement windows and whether billing via Marketplace is required for Cascade’s finance team. If Marketplace is required, we’ll kick off the private-offer enablement with our GCP marketplace engineer immediately.

I attached: Cascade_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP checklist) and a redacted SOC2 report for legal/finance review.

Propose a 30-minute alignment call on Fri Sep 12 at 10:00am PT — does that work for your team?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & procurement milestones for GCP private offer (Cascade Systems)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachments. A few quick notes from procurement/finance perspective:

- Cascade prefers Marketplace billing where possible, but our finance team requires ~6–8 business days to process a private-offer invoice and another 3–5 days for internal approvals (PO issuance). That would push signing to the end of next week if we start now.
- We need clarification on whether the Marketplace invoice will be consolidated monthly or itemized per charge; consolidated is preferable.
- Legal will want to see a minimal-data-flow diagram (PII/data residency callouts) and confirmation that logs/audit retention meet our 12-month retention requirement.

Chris (cc), is there anything technical to add re: evaluation criteria or the sandbox project?

We can do the 30-minute call on Sep 12 at 10:00am PT — Marta, Chris — does that work?

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement, Cascade Systems
marta.lopez@cascadesys.com

Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & procurement milestones for GCP private offer (Cascade Systems)

Thanks Marta — great notes. A few clarifications and an updated MAP attached (Cascade_MAP_v1.1.xlsx):

Billing options (short):
- Option A (preferred): GCP Marketplace private offer — single consolidated monthly invoice to Cascade. We will request consolidated billing at setup and share the Marketplace offer ID for your finance team.
- Option B (fallback): Redwood issues monthly invoices directly to Cascade — this shortens Marketplace enablement time but requires a separate vendor setup.

Compliance items:
- Confirmed: Redwood can provide a redacted SOC2 summary (attached) and an architecture/data-flow diagram that flags any PII-handling paths.
- Audit logs: 12-month retention is supported, we’ll include log retention SLA language in the SOW.

Procurement cadence update: based on your 6–8 business day processing, my suggested MAP (updated) slides target the internal PO request to finance by Sep 15 so we can sign by Sep 24. I attached a PO template (PO_template.docx) tailored for Marketplace flow and a revised spreadsheet with checkpoints.

Links and next steps:
- MAP doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-cascade-map
- DocuSign (PO template): https://www.docusign.com/requests/CAS-3892-po-template

If we’re aligned, I’ll get our GCP marketplace engineer to start private-offer onboarding this week and loop in legal for a short redline cycle. Confirm the 10:00am PT call and I’ll send calendar invite.

—Karthik
